SHARED-F-2-S128.title: Consent API & Tool Interface
SHARED-F-2-S128.description: Expose consent framework capabilities via FastAPI endpoints and tool_router integration, including capturing Tier 1 and Tier 2 consent, retrieving current consent status, and enabling tool-use flows to trigger consent prompts.

SHARED-F-2-S129.title: Consent Integration with Lead Capture & Unknowns
SHARED-F-2-S129.description: Integrate consent enforcement with downstream shared services (lead_capture and unknown_question_service) to ensure data handling aligns with granted consent tier, including blocking identifiable storage or triggering de-identification flows.
